newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs unaware of reason for share fall.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs unaware of reason for share fall.

text.p: Cortecs International Ltd said on Friday it was unaware of the reason for the drop in the company's share price.
Earlier, the Daily Mail reported that market bears were talking the stock down to 100p, saying "beware of bad news".
The newspaper did not give further details.
The biotech's shares fell 9-1/2 to 195-1/2 in afternoon trade in London, after falling 15p to 205p on Thursday.

"The company has seen the comment in today's press and confirms that it is not aware of any change in its development projects and business prospects that could account for the recent adjustments in its share price," Cortecs said in a statement.
